title: Working With Perpetrators
description: This module equips specialist DFV practitioners with the skills required to safely and ethically engage with people who use violence. It focuses on accountability frameworks, behaviour change principles, and risk‑aware engagement strategies that prioritise victim‑survivor safety.
outcomes: Engage safely and ethically with people who use violence
Apply accountability‑focused approaches that prioritise survivor safety
Understand behaviour change principles and their limitations in DFV contexts
